title: kid derivation
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 6. Step 5 — Sign as a COSE_Sign1; HCERT Specification, A.1 The Key Identifier (`kid`s). QR Code Generation, 6. Step 5 — Sign as a COSE_Sign1: “take the DER encoding of the DSC and use the first 8 bytes of its SHA-256 fingerprint”.

statements.label: kid derivation
statements.requirement: kid SHALL be the first 8 bytes of SHA-256 over the DER-encoded DSC. The issuer SHALL derive it from the Signer's DSC, not take it from the caller.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-KID-001 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-TRU-001 STT-KID-001 a DSC is found by its kid, the first 8 bytes of its SHA-256` (TrustListTest.kt); `STT-TST-001 STT-KID-001 the vector's kid is the DSC's` (ConformanceVectorsTest.kt)).
